chapter: Pope family and the Excelsior Band
title: Excelsior Band named for Pope's birth; father Alexander Pope
summary: Pope born 1883; his father and friends formed the Excelsior Band that day. His father died aged 88 some years ago.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: 1883, November 23rd. So you're 76 years old. 76 years old, this year. Now, as I'm saying, the Excelsior Band was practically born, you understand, on the day that I was born. And I was getting together. My father and his friends. And they organized a band and named it the Excelsior Band, you see.
Why did they choose Excelsior as a name? I don't know. But it was in honor of your birth. That's right.
Your father was Alexander Pope. That's right. John Alexander Pope.
But do you know when he was born? About how old he was when you were born?
Well, no, I don't know if he got to the date. But I know he would have been just a matter of which. That when he died, he would have been 88 years old. And when did he die?
Oh, he died about seven years ago, seven or eight years ago.
We didn't miss him by long.
